daily.text: A traveling merchant passes through town, bringing rare goods.
Children play in the streets. The town feels lively.
A minor dispute breaks out at the market.
A farmer's cart breaks down, delaying shipments.
A minstrel performs in the square, lifting spirits.
Bandits spotted on the trade road. Caravans delayed.
A good omen! A double rainbow over the kingdom.

Spring.text: Spring planting begins! Farms are busy.
The annual Spring Fair draws visitors to town.

Summer.text: Harvest season! The fields are golden.

Winter.text: Winter stores are full. The town is prepared.
A harsh blizzard isolates the town.
